temp_workers_seasonal.context: Today roughly 400,000 seasonal farm jobs and about 66,000 or more seasonal non-farm jobs a year are filled through these visas.

temp_workers_skilled.context: Today 85,000 new skilled-worker (H-1B) visas a year are issued under the main cap, with more at universities and research groups.

culture_tradeoff.why: 'Keep their own cultures' and 'one shared culture' had no examples.

0.text: Groups keep their own languages, holidays, foods and religious practices, even if people share less in common.

1.text: People adopt one shared culture, with English, the same national holidays and common customs, even if some traditions fade.
